question: Event bubbling kya hai?
options: Event pehle target element pe fire hota hai, phir upar propagate hota hai
Event neeche propagate hota hai
Event dono taraf jaata hai
Event sirf target pe hi rehta hai
explanation: Bubbling: event sabse pehle target pe fire hota hai, phir parent elements pe bubble karta hai tak tak root tak. Isi behavior pe event delegation based hai.

question: Event delegation pattern ka kya matlab hai?
options: Parent pe listener lagao, event child se bubble hoke aayega
Har child pe listener lagao
Delegation karo aur kisi pe mat lagao
Event capture karo
explanation: Delegation: ek parent pe listener lagao aur e.target se check karo kaunsa child click hua. Dynamic elements ke liye perfect — naye elements pe automatically kaam karega.

question: e.target aur this mein kya farq hai event handler mein?
options: e.target jis element pe click hua, this wo element jispe listener hai
Dono same hain
this jispe click hua, e.target jispe listener hai
Koi farq nahi
explanation: e.target = actual clicked element (event origin). this = element jispe listener attached hai. Delegation mein dono alag ho sakte hain.

question: e.stopPropagation() kya karta hai?
options: Event ko upar propagate hone se rokta hai
Event ko start hone se rokta hai
Default action rokta hai
Event delete karta hai
explanation: stopPropagation() event bubbling (ya capturing) rok deta hai — parent elements tak nahi jaata. preventDefault() alag hai — woh default action rokta hai.

question: 100 list items pe click tracking chahiye — best approach?
options: UL pe ek listener lagao, delegation se kaam hoga
Har LI pe alag listener lagao
innerHTML se saare listeners re-attach karo
Koi approach nahi
explanation: Delegation best hai — ek listener UL pe. Naye items automatically handle honge. Har element pe listener = memory waste aur performance issue.
